description: This file defines the interface SqlInjectionPreventerService, which provides methods for encoding SQL strings and quoting database identifiers to prevent SQL injection attacks.

classes.name: SqlInjectionPreventerService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for SQL injection prevention, including encoding SQL literals and quoting identifiers.

methods.name: encodeSql
methods.description: Encodes a SQL string literal to prevent injection.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Validates and quotes a database identifier with optional whitelist validation.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Validates and quotes a database identifier without whitelist validation.
